headline: Saturday, November 14 — breather day, cloudy 64, Abbie at Banfield 2:30

sections.lead: The storm moved on: cloudy, high 64, low 49, just 15% rain and a light 4 mph south breeze. Quiet day before the next round.
items: Hour by hour: 8am 52 mostly sunny, 10am 58, noon 62, 2pm 64 (day's peak), 4pm 62 cloudy, 6pm 57, 8pm 56, 10pm 56
All-day rain risk stays 1% or less, so errands are safe today
Week: Sun rain 70% 61/51, Mon sunny 59/44, Tue sunny 57/44, Wed heavy rain 85% 50/45, Thu rain 75% 53/47, Fri mostly sunny 59/45
Wednesday is the big one next week; Monday and Tuesday are your dry errand days

sections.lead: Last day of the heads-down Capricorn stretch: finish things this morning, then the mood lightens tonight when the Moon slides into Aquarius.
items: Plain read: one more morning where checklists feel good, then a lighter, more social Sunday
Midday the Moon grinds against your natal Moon, a little emotional static: don't schedule anything hard this afternoon, and let Abbie's vet visit be the main event
Your Mercury paperwork support is still exact, so if a form or reading needs doing, this morning is the slot
How to use it: Granite tasks and any forms this morning, vet at 2:30, low-key evening

Details: Moon Capricorn 24.8 entering Aquarius tonight, waxing crescent (62 deg elongation); Sun trine natal Mercury (orb 1.0); Neptune retro trine natal Venus (orb 0.7); Pluto sextile natal Moon (orb 1.0); Venus retro conjunct natal Moon (orb 2.0); Moon square natal Moon (orb 2.2); Mercury retro square natal Sun (orb 2.3); Saturn retro trine natal Sun (orb 2.4); first quarter Moon Monday

sections.lead: One new dispatch card surfaced and failed the pay check; the other two were yesterday's repeats.
items: New on LinkedIn: Vulcan Asphalt Dispatcher, Napa, posted pay $28.00-$32.00/hr, about $58-67K, under your $90K floor, so it was screened and skipped with the reason logged
Aubry Dispatch & Safety Coordinator (Hayward, under floor) and Cemex Dispatcher (French Camp, outside Bay Area/remote) are the same two cards from yesterday
Nothing new passed the filters, so the Job Hunt tab is unchanged

sections.lead: One more door closed, this one in the construction lane.
items: Herzog Contracting passed on you for Manager of Field Operations, Friday afternoon: 'we will not be moving forward, we appreciate your participation in our search'
No interview requests, nothing from Granite

sections.lead: Local news is thin this Saturday morning; three lines worth having.
items: The weather service declared this year's El Nino 'Super' status Thursday, which is the engine behind this week's storm train
Antioch police are still investigating the two hit-and-runs that hurt two pedestrians last weekend
Berkeley issued an East Bay warning about rabid bats after more tested positive; keep Abbie clear of anything crawling on the ground

sections.lead: Quiet Saturday, one appointment, and it is a rest day for the iron (next reminder Sunday morning).
items: Easy win: the four Granite onboarding tasks in Workday, 10 to 15 minutes total
2:30 to 3:30 PM: Abbie appt at Banfield (her calendar slot, yours)
No iron supplement today; the Sunday morning text reminder picks back up tomorrow
Routine continues: 10am apply run, 3pm construction-dispatch sweep, 5pm site check, 7pm apply run

sections.lead: Tony's and the Family calendars are clear for Saturday.
items: Nothing on either calendar
